answer: Like sedimentary crystallization compressing loose shale into bedrock, consensus solidifies through recursive stake-weighted attestations. A solitary whisper gains trust only as allied peers stake non-transferable bond reserves to validate its lineage. To forge phantom identities across this mycorrhizal web, an adversary faces exponential staking costs that outpace their reach, letting the network hunt down anomalies with the lethal precision of a falcon.
